C1143.title: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of NFT Wash Trading
C1143.summary: Through the analysis of over 2.7 million NFT sale events, this study identifies three types of NFT wash trading and proposes corresponding heuristic algorithms. Wash trading artificially inflates prices and volumes, constituting a fraudulent behavior in the NFT market.

references.title: The dark side of NFTs: A large-scale empirical study of wash trading
